items.q: And Peck Morrison was the bass player and, and, in Tiny Bradshaw's band but he was quitting

ctx.x: Up there--150th Street between Broadway and Amsterdam and got my bag. And we split. And Peck Morrison was the bass player and, and, in Tiny Bradshaw's band but he was quitting because he had something to do here in New York.
